source.author: Anastasia Kireeva
source.title: Low-degree hardness of finding the largest clique in Erdős–Rényi graph (problems 36-38)

outcomes.B5: Exact cactus chord-fugacity factorization; cycles untouched by the defect current cancel pointwise in the interpolation; for homogeneous t, mu_G(A) <= 2^{s(A)} t^{tau_G(A)} <= (2t)^{tau_G(A)}, valid with extensive cyclomatic number.
outcomes.B19: Exact deterministic group-code spectral certificate and a concrete expander-subcode class with zero source LDA through D_n and noisy TV convergence for every fixed positive refresh rate; generic exact LDPC minimum-distance solving explicitly rejected.
outcomes.B22: Exact Tanner near-dependency lower obstruction and calibrated binomial-baseline defect MGF; minimum odd boundary alone is insufficient, and trapping/current failure modes point to an entropy-versus-energy pressure criterion.
